question: Where can I find a park no more than 150 kilometers away to the northeast of Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowditch Middle School Auditorium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Foster City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), 150000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowditch Middle School Auditorium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Foster City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), ST_Centroid(geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
